content.text: The warranty package meets or exceeds the preferred position, so no redline is needed.

input.quote: 19.2 For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term. Vendor warrants it has authority to enter the Agreement and grant the rights stated here.
input.rationale: Section 19 delivers the preferred position in full: 19.1 gives a professional and workmanlike services warranty plus material conformity to documentation and specifications; 19.2 runs the Deliverable conformity warranty for ninety days from the later of delivery or acceptance and holds hosted Services to conformity for the entire subscription term (better than the 12-month software benchmark); 19.3 adds compliance with Applicable Law, no malicious code and open-source/functionality protections. Remedies in 19.4 are prompt re-performance, repair or replacement at no charge, escalating to termination and refund of Fees paid, and are expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims. The disclaimer in 19.5 is limited to implied warranties and expressly preserves express warranties, service levels, indemnities and stated remedies, so it does not swallow the express warranty. Nothing to redline.
